description: This file defines React components for a page layout, including a PageContainer with a sidebar, header, and content area, utilizing UI components and styling from a design system.

methods.name: PageWrapper
methods.description: A layout component that creates a grid container for the page, adjusting layout for mobile and larger screens.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: A component that renders a sidebar, toggling visibility based on isSidebarOpen prop.

methods.name: Content
methods.description: A component that renders the main content area with styling to handle overflow and scrolling.

methods.name: PageContainer
methods.description: Main component that composes the page layout with header, sidebar, and content, managing sidebar state.
